label: Bible Study
prompt: Pleasant words are as an _____, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verse: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
note: Kind words as health food — sweet going down, and good for the bones.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall the lame man _____ as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verse: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
note: The lame shall leap like a deer and the dumb shall sing — streams breaking out in the desert.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the _____ and harp.
verse: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
note: The Bible's final psalm calls out the whole band — trumpet, psaltery, harp, and then everything that has breath.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a _____ of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
verse: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
note: Jesus quotes this as he overturns the temple tables — Jeremiah first said it in the temple gate.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a _____?
verse: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
note: Eliab mocked his kid brother on the battlefield; David answered, 'Is there not a cause?' — then went out to face Goliath.
